AFG.name: Afghanistan
AFG.value: No group or gender restriction coded

A01a.specification: Person is born in Afghanistan to a citizen.

A01b.specification: Person is born abroad to two citizens. Or person is born abroad to a citizen and a non-citizen, and (1) one of the parents permanently resides in Afghanistan, or (2) the parents live outside Afghanistan and they select Afghan citizenship for the child by mutual consent.

A03a.specification: n.a.

A03b.specification: Person is found in Afghanistan and documents prove that the child cannot acquire the parents' citizenship.

A05.specification: Person is born in Afghanistan to foreign parents and intends to permanently live in Afghanistan after reaching the age of 18 years, unless citizenship of another country is acquired within 6 months after reaching the age of 18. Does not apply if parents are diplomats or work for an international organisation.
A05.category: Age restriction: person can only acquire citizenship after reaching the age of majority

A06.specification: Person has been resident in Afghanistan for 5 years. Other conditions: no crime committed during his/her stay in Afghanistan.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A06a.specification: Person has been resident in Afghanistan for 5 years.

A06c.specification: n.a.
A06c.category: No requirement

A06e.specification: No crime committed during his/her stay in Afghanistan.
A06e.category: Exclusion for certain specified crimes, offences or character queries

A06f.category: No requirement

A08.specification: Person is the spouse of a citizen and the marriage was concluded in accordance with Islamic Sharia law.

A10.specification: n.a.
A10.category: No provision

A14.specification: Person is the minor child of parents who are acquiring citizenship, or one parent is acquiring citizenship and the child lives with him/her. Children who have reached the age of 18 years and live abroad can 'request' citizenship if both parents are acquiring citizenship.; Person is the minor child of a foreign widow(er), is living with that parent, and the parent is marrying a citizen and acquiring citizenship.; Person is the minor child of a foreign separated parent, is living with that parent in Afghanistan, and the parent is marrying a citizen and acquiring citizenship. If the child and parent do not reside in Afghanistan, the other separated parent must consent to the child acquiring citizenship.
A14.category: Age restriction: only if child is minor

A16.specification: Person is a former citizen and his/her request for reacquisition is approved by the Council of Ministers and signed by the president.
A16.category: Generally applicable provision

A23.specification: Person does not have citizenship of any country. Other conditions: see A06.; Person does not have citizenship of any country and marries a citizen.

A24.specification: n.a.
A24.category: No provision

AGO.name: Angola
AGO.value: No group or gender restriction coded
AGO.naturalisation_language_condition: Language requirement with certification or test

A01a.specification: Person is born in Angola to a citizen.

A01b.specification: Person is born abroad to a citizen.

A03a.specification: Person is found in Angolan territory as a newborn child.

A03b.specification: Person is born in territory and does not possess any other citizenship, or person is born in territory of parents who are stateless or of unknown citizenship.

A06.specification: Person has been resident in Angola for 10 years. Other conditions: able to govern him/herself and secure subsistence (evidenced by regular tax payment in previous 3 years), sufficient knowledge of Portuguese as proved in an exam, effective ties to national community proved by exam, adequate knowledge of rights and duties under the constitution, not convicted of crime punishable by more than 3 years in prison. Grounds for opposition: lack of effective ties to the national community, conviction in final instance for crime punishable with prison sentence of 3 years or more or for crime against the security of the state.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A06a.specification: Person has been resident in Angola for 10 years.

A06c.specification: Person has sufficient knowledge of Portuguese as proved in an exam.
A06c.category: Language requirement with certification or test

A06d.specification: Person has effective link to national community proved by exam, adequate knowledge of rights and duties under the constitution.

A06e.specification: Person is not convicted of crime punishable by more than 3 years in prison.
A06e.category: Exclusion for certain specified crimes, offences or character queries

A06f.specification: Person is able to govern him/herself and secure subsistence (evidenced by regular tax payment in previous 3 years).
A06f.category: Requirement (conditions not further specified in database)

A08.specification: Person has been the spouse or legally recognised partner of a citizen for 5 years, with common household. Other conditions: required to be adult, show integration in Angolan society, and no conviction of crime. Grounds for opposition: lack of effective ties to the national community, conviction in final instance for crime punishable with prison sentence of 3 years or more or for crime against the security of the state.

A10.specification: Person is a minor who is adopted by a citizen. Other conditions: if person is over 14, s/he must demonstrate willingness to become a citizen. Grounds for opposition: lack of effective ties to the national community, conviction in final instance for crime punishable with prison sentence of 3 years or more or for crime against the security of the state.
A10.category: Age restriction: only if adopted child is a minor

A14.specification: Person is without legal capacity and either parent acquires citizenship. Person has to submit a separate request and provide proof that one of the parents has acquired Angolan citizenship. Grounds for opposition: lack of effective ties to the national community, conviction in final instance for crime punishable with prison sentence of 3 years or more or for crime against the security of the state.
A14.category: Age restriction: only if child is minor

A16.specification: Person is a former citizen who renounced citizenship or who lost it because s/he worked for a foreign state. Grounds for opposition: lack of effective ties to the national community, conviction in final instance for crime punishable with prison sentence of 3 years or more or for crime against the security of the state, exercise of sovereign functions for a foreign state, except if authorised by the Parliament, rendering of military service to a foreign state, attempt to reacquire citizenship for a second time.
A16.category: Mode restriction: only if citizenship was lost on particular grounds

A24.specification: Person has rendered services to the country or has exceptional professional, scientific or artistic qualifications. Other conditions: National Assembly grants after debate on request of at least 15 deputies.; Person has rendered relevant services to the state. Other conditions: president grants on basis conditions provided under mode A06, except that residence period, financial requirements, and knowledge of Portuguese may be waived.
A24.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A24.specification:
Person has rendered services to the country or has exceptional professional, scientific or artistic qualifications. Other conditions: National Assembly grants after debate on request of at least 15 deputies.; 
Person has rendered relevant services to the state. Other conditions: president grants on basis conditions provided under mode A06, except that residence period, financial requirements, and knowledge of Portuguese may be waived.
A24.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

ALB.name: Albania
ALB.value: No group or gender restriction coded
ALB.naturalisation_language_condition: Language requirement without certification or test

A01a.specification: Person is born in Albania to a citizen.
Everyone born of at least one parent with Albanian citizenship acquires Albanian citizenship automatically and is registered as such.

A01b.specification: Person is born abroad to a citizen.
Everyone born of at least one parent with Albanian citizenship acquires Albanian citizenship automatically and is registered as such.

A02a.specification: Person is born to parents of another country who are lawful residents in Albania and both parents give their consent to acquisition of citizenship.

A03a.specification: Person is found in Albania of unknown parentage and would otherwise be stateless.
Child found in Albania of unknown parentage and would otherwise be stateless.

A03b.specification: n.a.

A06.specification: Person has been lawfully resident in Albania for at least 5 continuous years. Other conditions: dwelling and sufficient income, no sentence in any country for a criminal offence that carries a prison sentence of at least 3 years (exemption only if the sentence was given for political motives), elementary knowledge of the Albanian language, no danger to security and defence of Albania.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A06.specification: Person has turned 18, possesses legal capacity to act, has been lawfully resident in Albania for 7 continuous years and posseses permanent residence permit that is available at the time of application, possesses dwelling and sufficient income, has not been sentenced in any country for a criminal offence that carries a prison sentence of at least 3 years (exemption only if the sentence was given for political motives), possesses knowledge of Albanian language (in writing and speech),  does not pose a threat to public order and national security of the Republic of Albania.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A06a.specification: Person has been lawfully resident in Albania for at least 5 continuous years.
Person  has been lawfully resident in Albania for 7 continuous years and posseses permanent residence permit that is available at the time of application

A06c.specification: Person has elementary knowledge of the Albanian language.
A06c.category: Language requirement without certification or test

A06c.specification: Person possesses knowledge of Albanian language (in writing and speech)
A06c.category: Language requirement without certification or test

A06d.specification: Person has turned 18, possesses legal capacity to act, has been lawfully resident in Albania for 7 continuous years and posseses permanent residence permit that is available at the time of application, possesses dwelling and sufficient income, has not been sentenced in any country for a criminal offence that carries a prison sentence of at least 3 years (exemption only if the sentence was given for political motives), possesses knowledge of Albanian language (in writing and speech),  does not pose a threat to public order and national security of the Republic of Albania.

A06e.specification: Person is not a danger to security and defence of Albania, no sentence in any country for a criminal offence that carries a prison sentence of at least 3 years (exemption only if the sentence was given for political motives).
A06e.category: Exclusion for certain specified crimes, offences or character queries and general moral character condition applies

A06e.specification: Person has turned 18, possesses legal capacity to act, has been lawfully resident in Albania for 7 continuous years and posseses permanent residence permit that is available at the time of application, possesses dwelling and sufficient income, has not been sentenced in any country for a criminal offence that carries a prison sentence of at least 3 years (exemption only if the sentence was given for political motives), possesses knowledge of Albanian language (in writing and speech),  does not pose a threat to public order and national security of the Republic of Albania.
A06e.category: Exclusion for certain specified crimes, offences or character queries and general moral character condition applies

A06f.specification: Person has dwelling and sufficient income.
A06f.category: Requirement (conditions not further specified in database)

A06f.specification: Person has turned 18, possesses legal capacity to act, has been lawfully resident in Albania for 7 continuous years and posseses permanent residence permit that is available at the time of application, possesses dwelling and sufficient income, has not been sentenced in any country for a criminal offence that carries a prison sentence of at least 3 years (exemption only if the sentence was given for political motives), possesses knowledge of Albanian language (in writing and speech),  does not pose a threat to public order and national security of the Republic of Albania.
A06f.category: Requirement (conditions not further specified in database)

A08.specification: Person has been married to an Albanian citizen for at least 3 years and has lawfully and continuously resided in Albania for 1 year.
Person has been married to an Albanian citizen for at least 3 years and has lawfully and continuously resided in Albania for 1 year.

A10.specification: Person is a minor and is adopted by two citizens, or by one citizen and both parents reside in Albania at the time of adoption, or is stateless or becomes stateless as a result of the adoption.
A10.category: Age restriction: only if adopted child is a minor

A10.specification: Person is a minor and is adopted by two citizens, or by one citizen and both parents reside in Albania at the time of adoption, or is stateless or becomes stateless as a result of the adoption.
A10.category: Age restriction: only if adopted child is a minor

A12a.specification: Person is a direct descendant up to the 2nd generation and has been resident in Albania for at least 3 continuous years. Other conditions: see A06.
A12a.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A12a.specification: Person is a direct descendant up to the 3nd generation.
A12a.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A14.specification: Person is a minor who lives with his/her parents, and both parents are acquiring citizenship by naturalisation and request that the child be included (child must consent if between the age of 14-18). If only one parent is acquiring citizenship by naturalisation, the minor acquires citizenship if so requested by both parents, or by one of the parents if the other parent is stateless, and the child is resident in Albania.
A14.category: Age restriction: only if child is minor

A14.specification: Person is a minor who lives with his/her parents, and both parents are acquiring citizenship by naturalisation and request that the child be included (child must consent if between the age of 14-18). If only one of the parents acquires Albanian citizenship, however, his or her children under 18 years of age, who reside in Albania, become Albanian citizens if that is requested by both parents or by one of the parents. This excludes cases when the other parent can not give his/her consent for objective reasons.
A14.category: Age restriction: only if child is minor

A16.specification: n.a.
A16.category: No provision

A16.specification: A person who has relinquished Albanian citizenship and wants to reaquire can apply if he or she fulfills the following conditions: is 18, possesses legal capacity to act,  has not been sentenced in any country for a criminal offence that carries a prison sentence of at least 3 years (exemption only if the sentence was given for political motives) and does not pose a threat to public order and national security of the Republic of Albania.
A16.category: No provision

A19.specification: Person is born to a parent of Albanian origin, regardless of the place of birth. Excludes people of Albanian origin who are citizens of Kosovo.; Person is of Albanian origin and 1) is a citizen (or documented resident) of an EU member state, the United States of America or another state the citizens of which are not required to hold a visa to travel in the states belonging to the Schengen Area. OR 2) possesses another citizenship or is stateless and one parent is an Albanian citizen. OR 3) person possesses another citizenship or is stateless and was born in Albania. Or person's ancestors were in possession of citizenship and are no longer alive at the time of request, provided that the person can prove direct descent (up to the 3rd generation) from such a citizen ancestor. Excludes people of Albanian origin who are citizens of Kosovo
A19.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A22.specification: Person has turned 18, possesses legal capacity to act, has been lawfully resident in Albania for 7 continuous years from the day they acquired refugee status in Albania, posseses dwelling and sufficient income, has not been sentenced in any country for a criminal offence that carries a prison sentence of at least 3 years (exemption only if the sentence was given for political motives), possesses knowledge of Albanian language (in writing and speech),  does not pose a threat to public order and national security of the Republic of Albania.

A23.specification: Person is a minor or adult and has been resident in Albania for 5 continuous years. Other conditions: no danger to security and defence of Albania.

Person is a minor or adult and has been resident in Albania for 7 continuous years and posseses permanent residence permit that is available at the time of application, has not been sentenced in any country for a criminal offence that carries a prison sentence of at least 3 years (exemption only if the sentence was given for political motives) and  does not pose a threat to public order and national security of the Republic of Albania.

A24.specification: Person is someone whose acquisition of citizenship would be in special (scientific, economic, cultural or national) interest of Albania. Other conditions: no danger to security and defence of Albania.
A24.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A24.specification: Person is someone whose acquisition of citizenship would be in special (scientific, economic, cultural or national) interest of Albania. Other conditions: no danger to security and defence of Albania.
A24.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A26.specification: Person is someone whose acquisition of citizenship would be in special economic interest of Albania. Other conditions: no danger to security and defence of Albania.
A26.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A26.specification: Person is someone whose acquisition of citizenship would be in special economic interest of Albania. Other conditions: no danger to security and defence of Albania.
A26.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

ARE.name: United Arab Emirates
ARE.gender_restriction_modes: Descent (born in country): Gender restriction: no or restricted access if the mother is a citizen (wedlock condition/supplementary provision may apply); Descent (born abroad): Gender restriction: no or restricted access if the mother is a citizen (wedlock condition/supplementary provision may apply); Marriage: Gender restriction: only for female spouse of male citizen (with residence requirement); Spousal coacquisition: Gender restriction: only applies to female spouses (without residence requirement)
ARE.naturalisation_language_condition: Language requirement without certification or test

A01a.specification: Person is born in the UAE to a male citizen, or to a female citizen and the father is unknown or stateless; Person is born to a female citizen who is married to a foreign citizen. Citizenship can be acquired six years after the date of birth, and only if the mother had citizenship during the period from the date of birth until the date of submission of the request.
A01a.category: Gender restriction: no or restricted access if the mother is a citizen (wedlock condition/supplementary provision may apply)

A06.specification: Person has been resident in the UAE for at least 30 years, according to UAE 8. Other conditions: renunciation of original citizenship, lawful and continuous residence in UAE, proficient in Arabic, legitimate means of income, educational qualification, good character, not convicted for crimes of dishonour (unless person has been rehabilitated), obtained security approval, sworn an oath of allegiance. Facilited acquisition: Person who is Arab has been resident in the UAE at least seven years, according to UAE 6, and three years if the person is from certain countries, see A18 and UAE 5. Other conditions apply.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A01b.specification: Person is born in the UAE to a male citizen, or to a female citizen and the father is unknown or stateless; Person is born to a female citizen who is married to a foreign citizen. Citizenship can be acquired six years after the date of birth, and only if the mother had citizenship during the period from the date of birth until the date of submission of the request.
A01b.category: Gender restriction: no or restricted access if the mother is a citizen (wedlock condition/supplementary provision may apply)

A01b.specification:
Person is born in the UAE to a male citizen, or to a female citizen and the father is unknown or stateless; 
Person is born to a female citizen who is married to a foreign citizen. Citizenship can be acquired six years after the date of birth, and only if the mother had citizenship during the period from the date of birth until the date of submission of the request.
A01b.category: Gender restriction: no or restricted access if the mother is a citizen (wedlock condition/supplementary provision may apply)

A03a.specification: Person is born in the UAE to unknown parents.

A03b.specification: n.a.

A06e.specification: Person must have good character, not convicted for crimes of dishonour (unless person has been rehabilitated), obtained security approval.
A06e.category: Exclusion for certain specified crimes, offences or character queries and general moral character condition applies

A06f.specification: Legitimate means of income, educational qualification required.
A06f.category: Requirement (conditions not further specified in database)

A08.specification: Person is the wife of a male citizen and the couple have been married for at least 10 years (reduced to 7 years if couple has children). Other conditions: see A06 (exemption may be granted from educational qualification requirement).
A08.category: Gender restriction: only for female spouse of male citizen (with residence requirement)

A10.specification: n.a.
A10.category: No provision

A13.specification: Person is the wife of someone who is acquiring citizenship and provided she renounces her original citizenship. Condition of renunciation of original citizenship is excempt if her husband is a naturalised citizen according to A26.
A13.category: Gender restriction: only applies to female spouses (without residence requirement)

A14.specification: No conditions given.
A14.category: Age restriction: only if child is minor

A16.specification: Person had obtained a foreign citizenship and has meanwhile renounced that citizenship. A minor who lost citizenship may regain it after reaching the age of majority.
A16.category: Mode restriction: only if citizenship was lost on particular grounds

A18.specification: Person is an Arab of Omani, Qatari or Bahraini origin and s/he has been resident in the UAE legally and continuously for more than 3 years immediately preceding his/her application for citizenship. Other conditions: legal means of living, good conduct, and not been convicted for a crime that impugns integrity.

A06c.specification: Proficiency in Arabic required.
A06c.category: Language requirement without certification or test

A24.specification: Person has special skills. No residence requirement. Other requirements: see A06.
A24.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A06a.specification: Person has been resident in the UAE for at least 30 years if non-Arab and three or seven years if Arab (lawful and continuous residence in UAE).

A06b.specification: Renunciation of original citizenship required. Exception made to naturalised citizens based on UAE 9 bis (see A24/A26).

A06d.specification: Person must have sworn an oath of allegiance.

A26.specification: Person is investor, businessman, highly skilled worker or exceptionally talented. Person an be exempt from some or all conditions for naturalisation (A06a-A06f), including renunciation of original citizenship.
A26.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

ARG.name: Argentina
ARG.value: No group or gender restriction coded

A01b.article: ARG 1(2), 5, Decree 3213/84 2;  Law 16.569 as modified by Law 25.327
A01b.specification: Person is born abroad to a citizen who was born in Argentina.;  Person is born abroad to a citizen who was exiled from Argentina. Option right can be exercised after arrival in the country.
A01b.category: Generational transmission restriction: conditional on birthplace/place of residence /mode under which parent acquired citizenship

A01b.article: ARG 1(2), 5, Decree 3213/84 2;  Law 16.569 as modified by Law 25.327
A01b.specification: Person is born abroad to a citizen who was born in Argentina.;  Person is born abroad to a citizen who was exiled from Argentina. Option right can be exercised after arrival in the country.
A01b.category: Generational transmission restriction: conditional on birthplace/place of residence /mode under which parent acquired citizenship

A02a.specification: Person is born in Argentina. Unless parents are foreign diplomats.

A01a.specification: n.a.

A03a.specification: n.a.

A06.specification: Person has been resident in Argentina for a continuous period of at least 2 years preceding his/her request in accordance with the regulatory framework on immigration and expresses his or her will to acquire citizenship before a federal district judge. Other conditions: honest source of income or occupation, no convictions for a crime committed in Argentina or abroad that carries a prison sentence of 3 years or more (unless the sentence has been served and the application for naturalisation is submitted 5 years after serving the sentence, or when amnesty has been granted), no criminal proceedings initiatives against the person in Argentina or abroad, and oath of loyalty. Judge may deny naturalisation if the applicant publicly advocates the overthrow of the democratic system, the use of violence, or denies the value of the human rights system. Political, ideological, trade union-related, religious or racial considerations can have no effect on the acquisition of citizenship.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A06.specification: Person has been resident in Argentina for a continuous period of at least 2 years preceding his/her request and expresses his or her will to acquire citizenship before a federal district judge. Other conditions: honest source of income or occupation, no convictions for a crime committed in Argentina or abroad that carries a prison sentence of 3 years or more (unless the sentence has been served and the application for naturalisation is submitted 5 years after serving the sentence, or when amnesty has been granted), no criminal proceedings initiatives against the person in Argentina or abroad, and oath of loyalty. Judge may deny naturalisation if the applicant publicly advocates the overthrow of the democratic system, the use of violence, or denies the value of the human rights system. Political, ideological, trade union-related, religious or racial considerations can have no effect on the acquisition of citizenship.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A06a.specification: Person has been resident in Argentina for a continuous period of at least 2 years preceding his/her request in accordance with the regulatory framework on immigration.
Person has been resident in Argentina for a continuous period of at least 2 years preceding his/her request.

A06c.specification: n.a.
A06c.category: No requirement

A03b.specification: n.a.

A06f.specification: Honest source of income or occupation.
A06f.category: Requirement (conditions not further specified in database)

A08.specification: Person is the spouse of a citizen. Other conditions: see A06 (except residence requirement). (Note: Provision used to discriminate between men and women. After the ratification by Argentina of the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women on 15 July 1985 and the adoption of the 1994 Argentinean Constitution which includes this convention in Art. 75 (22), this discrimination ceased to exist and the provision applies to both men and women.)

A09.specification: Person is the child of a father who acquired citizenship by naturalisation. Other conditions: the person was a minor at the time of the parent's naturalisation, was born abroad and he/she enrols in the National Guard under the age-conditions prescribed by the pertinent law.
A09.category: Generally applicable provision (child can be minor or adult)

A10.specification: n.a.
A10.category: No provision

A12a.specification: Person is the child of a father who acquired citizenship of another country by naturalisation. Other conditions: he or she enrols in the National Guard under the time-conditions prescribed by pertinent law.
A12a.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A14.specification: n.a.
A14.category: No provision

A16.specification: Person lost citizenship due to de facto laws 21.795 and 21.610 (i.e. enacted by the dictatorship). Re-acquisition is automatic unless the person manifests the contrary via judicial process.
A16.category: Mode restriction: only if citizenship was lost on particular grounds

A24.specification: Person is an entrepreneur or builder in the field of railway construction, part of an established colony and own real estate in the country, populates an Argentinean national territory, or is a teacher in any field of education or industry. Other conditions: see A06 (except residence requirement).; Person has established a new industry or introduced a useful invention. Other conditions: see A06 (except residence requirement).
A24.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A25.specification: Person has honourably fulfiled, in Argentina or abroad, a function in the service of Argentina, or has militarily defended the country. Other conditions: see A06 (except residence requirement).
A25.category: Generally applicable provision (applicable to military and public service)

A06e.specification: No convictions for a crime committed in Argentina or abroad that carries a prison sentence of 3 years or more (unless the sentence has been served and the application for naturalisation is submitted 5 years after serving the sentence, or when amnesty has been granted), no criminal proceedings initiatives against the person in Argentina or abroad. Judge may deny naturalisation if the applicant publicly advocates the overthrow of the democratic system, the use of violence, or denies the value of the human rights system.
A06e.category: Exclusion for certain specified crimes, offences or character queries

A11.specification: Regardless of the time of residence, a foreigner may naturalise if they have a child who is a national by birth (e.g. has been born in Argentina).
A11.category: Generational restriction: only if person is a parent of a citizen

ARM.name: Armenia
ARM.value: No group or gender restriction coded
ARM.naturalisation_language_condition: Language requirement without certification or test
ARM.cultural_affinity_route: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)
ARM.refugee_route: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A01b.specification: Person is born to parents who are both citizens or to a parent who is a citizen and the other parent is unknown or stateless. If one parent is a citizen and the other parent is a foreigner, the child acquires citizenship based on a written consent. In the absence of written consent, the child acquires citizenship if she or he is otherwise stateless, or both parents reside permanently in Armenia.

A03a.specification: Person is a child is found in Armenia of unknown parentage. This can be changed in case of discovery of at least one of the parents or a trustee.

A03b.specification: Person is born in Armenia to stateless parents or parents whose nationality is unknown or parents who cannot transfer their citizenship to their child.

A06a.specification: Person has been lawfully resident in Armenia for 3 years.

A06c.specification: Proficiency in the Armenian language required.
A06c.category: Language requirement without certification or test

A06d.specification: Familiarity with the Constitution of the Republic of Armenia required.

A06e.specification: Person's activities may not violate state and social security, public order, protection of the public health and traditions or rights, freedoms, dignity and good reputation of others.
A06e.category: General requirement without specification (good moral character)

A06e.specification: Person's activities do not violate and there is no reasonable suspicion that they may violate state and social security, public order, protection of the public health and traditions or rights, freedoms, dignity and good reputation of others.
A06e.category: General requirement without specification (good moral character)

A06f.category: No requirement

A06.specification: Person has been lawfully resident in Armenia for 3 years. Other conditions: proficiency in the Armenian language, familiarity with the Constitution of the Republic of Armenia, his/her activities do not violate state and social security, public order, protection of the public health and traditions or rights, freedoms, dignity and good reputation of others, and oath of allegiance.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A06.specification: Person has been lawfully resident in Armenia for 3 years. Other conditions: proficiency in the Armenian language, familiarity with the Constitution of the Republic of Armenia, his/her activities do not violate or may not violate state and social security, public order, protection of the public health and traditions or rights, freedoms, dignity and good reputation of others, and oath of allegiance.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A09.specification: Person has a father and/or mother who is/are citizens. Other conditions: see A06 (except residence requirement and language proficiency).
A09.category: Generally applicable provision (child can be minor or adult)

A10.specification: Person is a child both whose adoptive parents are citizens. If one parent is a foreigner, the child acquires citizenship if a) both parents give their consent, or b) the child resides in the country, or c) the child would otherwise be stateless.
A10.category: Age restriction: only if adopted child is a minor

A11.specification: Person has a child who is a citizen. Other conditions: see A06 (except residence requirement and language proficiency).
A11.category: Generational restriction: only if person is a parent of a citizen

A12a.specification: Person is the child of a parent(s) who held citizenship of the country in the past or the person was born on the territory of the country and applies for citizenship of Armenia within 3 years of reaching the age of 18 years. Other conditions: see A06 (except residence requirement).
A12a.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A12a.specification: Person is the child of a parent(s) who held citizenship of the country in the past and must permanently reside in the country during the previous year at the time of application. Other conditions: see A06 (except residence requirement).
A12a.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A08.specification: Person is married to a citizen for at least two years and has resided in Armenia for at least 365 days. Other conditions: see A06 (except residence requirement and language proficiency).

A18.specification: Person is a stateless person or former citizen of another USSR republic, is not a foreign citizen, permanently residing in Armenia and applied for citizenship before 31 December 2019.

A19.specification: Person is Armenian by origin and has resided in Armenia. Other conditions: see A06 (except residence requirement).; Person has ancestors who were Armenian by ethnic origin.; Person is an ethnic Armenian child who takes up permanent residence in Armenia.
A19.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A20.specification: Person has applied for citizenship in a manner prescribed by law and received a document confirming that he/she is a citizen. Recognition of citizen is retroactive until the date on which the Citizenship Act of 1995 came into force.
A20.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A22.specification: Person is a recognised refugee. Other conditions: see A06 (except residence requirement and language requirement).
A22.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A24.specification: Person has provided exceptional services to the country. No other conditions.
A24.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A24.specification: Person has provided exceptional services to the country, or services in the fields of economy, science, education, culture, healthcare, persons with a significant contribution in the fields of sports. No other conditions.
A24.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A14.specification: Person is under 18 years old and both parents are acquiring citizenship of the country. If one parent is a foreigner or stateless person the consent of both parents is required, unless the child resides in the country and the parent who is a citizen gives his/her consent. If child is 14-18 years old, the child's consent is required.
A14.category: Age restriction: only if child is minor

A16.specification: Person is (1) a citizen of the former Armenian SSR permanently residing on the territory of the Republic of Armenia, who until the enactment of the Constitution has not acquired citizenship of  another State or has rejected that citizenship within 1 year from the day of the enactment of the Armenian Citizenship Law. Or person is (2) a former citizen of the Armenian SSR, who lives outside the Republic of Armenia and has not acquired another citizenship. Or person has (3) lost citizenship of Armenia unless s/he was deprived of it. Or (4) person renounced citizenship after 1995 (exemption from residence and language requirements).  Or (5) person has renounced Armenian citizenship in order to acquire another citizenship, but has not received citizenship of another country.
A16.category: Mode restriction: only if citizenship was lost on particular grounds

A01a.specification: Person is born to parents who are both citizens or to a parent who is a citizen and the other parent is unknown or stateless. If one parent is a citizen and the other parent is a foreigner, the child acquires citizenship based on a written consent. In the absence of written consent, the child acquires citizenship if s/he is otherwise stateless, or both parents reside permanently in Armenia.

ATG.name: Antigua and Barbuda
ATG.value: No group or gender restriction coded

A01a.specification: n.a.

A01b.specification: Person is born abroad to a citizen who was born in Antigua and Barbuda, or to a citizen who is in the service of the government, or to a deceased parent who held Antigua and Barbuda citizenship.
A01b.category: Generational transmission restriction: conditional on birthplace/place of residence /mode under which parent acquired citizenship

A02a.specification: Person is born in Antigua and Barbuda unless the child is born to a foreign diplomat and neither parent is a citizen, or one of the parents is an enemy alien and the child is born in a place then under occupation by the enemy.

A03a.specification: Person is a newborn infant found in Antigua and Barbuda of unknown parentage.

A03b.specification: Person is a minor or adult who was born in Antigua and Barbuda and has always been stateless. Registration can be denied in the interests of defense or public order, if the person is sentenced to death or to a prison sentence of at least 12 months, is not of good character, is a danger to public safety, has been declared bankrupt, or has insufficient means to support him/herself.

A04.specification: Father acknowledges, and can show he is the parent of, the child or a Court has judged him to be the father. Also, alleged father has signed, and had notarised, an instrument recognizing paternity, which has been deposited with the Registry.
A04.category: Generally applicable provision (no further conditions besides recognition/legitimation/establishment of parentage)

A06.specification: Person has been resident in Antigua and Barbuda for 12 months immediately prior to the application (exemption for British protected persons), as well as during 5 out of 7 years predating the 12-month period. Other conditions: good character, full capacity, intent to reside in Antigua and Barbuda, and oath of allegiance. Minister is explicitly allowed to waive certain requirements. Minister may refuse to grant citizenship in interest of public safety, morality, order and defence.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A06.specification: Person has been resident in Antigua and Barbuda for 12 months immediately prior to the application (exemption for British protected persons), as well as during 5 out of 7 years predating the 12-month period. Periods of six months or more during which the person was not legally resident in Antigua and Barbuda shall not be taken into account. Other conditions: good character, full capacity, intent to reside in Antigua and Barbuda, and oath of allegiance. Minister is explicitly allowed to waive certain requirements. Minister may refuse to grant citizenship in interest of public safety, morality, order and defence.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A06c.specification: n.a.
A06c.category: No requirement

A06d.specification: Person must take an oath of allegiance.

A06e.specification: Person must be of good character. Minister may refuse to grant citizenship in interest of public safety, morality, order and defence. Minister is explicitly allowed to waive certain requirements.
A06e.category: General requirement without specification (good moral character)

A06f.category: No requirement

A08.specification: Person has been the spouse of a citizen, with common household, for 3 years. If spouse died during that period and would have become an Antigua and Barbuda citizen, widow can apply for citizenship. Other conditions: oath of loyalty.

A10.specification: Person is a minor who is adopted by a citizen or, in case of joint adoption, by a male citizen. Other conditions: oath of loyalty.
A10.category: Age restriction: only if adopted child is a minor

A11.specification: Parent or grandparent of the citizenship by investment applicant. Other conditions: must be over 65 years old, living with the applicant and fully dependent on the applicant.
A11.category: Generally applicable provision (applies to relatives in ascending and descending line)

A12b.specification: Person is born abroad and parent was or would have been a citizen ex Const 112 but for his/her death.; Spouse of deceased citizen must have been married to the latter for at least 3 years.
A12b.category: Generally applicable provision (applies to descendant or spouse)

A13.specification: Spouse must have been married for at least 3 years to person who becomes a citizen (or who would have but for death become a citizen) and must have been residing with person who becomes a citizen.

A14.specification: Child must be under age 18. If child is adopted or the stepchild of citizen parent, the child must have been 'recognised by law'.; Citizenship By Investment Programme: Child of the main applicant or his or her spouse who is less than 18 years of age, or 18-26 years of age and who is in full time attendance at a recognised institution of higher education and fully supported by the main applicant, or at least 18 years of age and physically or mentally challenged and who is living with and fully supported by the main applicant
A14.category: Age restriction: only if child is minor

A14.specification: Child must be under age 18. If child is adopted or the stepchild of citizen parent, the child must have been 'recognised by law'.;  Citizenship By Investment Programme: Child of the main applicant or his or her spouse who is less than 18 years of age, or 18-26 years of age and who is in full time attendance at a recognised institution of higher education and fully supported by the main applicant, or at least 18 years of age and physically or mentally challenged and who is living with and fully supported by the main applicant
A14.category: Age restriction: only if child is minor

A16.specification: Person is a former citizen who had to renounce citizenship in order to acquire or retain citizenship of another country. Other conditions: oath of loyalty.
A16.category: Mode restriction: only if citizenship was lost on particular grounds

A18.specification: Person is a Commonwealth citizen of full capacity and has been ordinarily resident in Antigua and Barbuda, or has been in the service of the government, or has had partly such residence and partly such service for at least 5 out of 7 years immediately prior to the application. Minister is explicitly allowed to waive certain requirements. Registration can be denied in the interests of defense or public order, or if the person is sentenced to death or to a prison sentence of at least 12 months, is not of good character, is a danger to public safety, has been declared bankrupt, or has insufficient means to support him/herself.

A24.specification: n.a.
A24.category: No provision

A25.specification: Person is from a First Schedule country, of full mind and capacity, and has been in Government service, or partly in Government service while ordinarily resident in Antigua and Barbuda. Grounds for refusal include interests of defence, public safety, morality and order, as well as conviction for a criminal offence, being of poor character, engaging in activities prejudicial to Antigua and Barbuda and likelihood of becoming a public charge.
A25.category: Generally applicable provision (applicable to military and public service)

A26.article: Investment Act 5(1), 5(2), Schedule of Fees (Regulations 4(3) and 5(2))
A26.specification: Person is at least 18 years old and whose acquisition of citizenship would be in the special economic interest of Antigua and Barbuda. Other conditions: oath of loyalty, provision of police and medical certificates, payment of fee.
A26.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A06a.specification: Person has been resident in Antigua and Barbuda for 12 months immediately prior to the application (exemption for British protected persons), as well as during 5 out of 7 years predating the 12-month period. Periods during which the person was not legally resident in Antigua and Barbuda shall not be taken into account. Person must have intent to reside in Antigua and Barbuda. Minister is explicitly allowed to waive certain requirements.

Person has been resident in Antigua and Barbuda for 12 months immediately prior to the application (exemption for British protected persons), as well as during 5 out of 7 years predating the 12-month period. Periods of six months or more during which the person was not legally resident in Antigua and Barbuda shall not be taken into account. Person must have intent to reside in Antigua and Barbuda. Minister is explicitly allowed to waive certain requirements.

AUS.name: Australia
AUS.value: No group or gender restriction coded
AUS.naturalisation_language_condition: Language requirement with certification or test

A01a.specification: Person is born in Australia to a citizen or permanent resident (with exceptions for birth to an enemy alien in occupied territory).

A02a.specification: Person is born in Australia to parent with permanent residence status.

A01b.specification: Person is born abroad to a citizen. Only requirement for applying to become a citizen is that a responsible parent be a citizen at time of birth and that, if aged over 18, the person is of good character. If the parent was a citizen by descent or by overseas adoption by a citizen then, unless the person was never a citizen of another country, the parent must have spent a total of 2 years in Australia at any time before application for citizenship.
A01b.category: Generational transmission restriction: conditional on birthplace/place of residence /mode under which parent acquired citizenship

A03b.specification: Person has never been the national or citizen of any other country, and is 'not entitled to acquire' the nationality or citizenship of a foreign country.

A03a.specification: Person is found in Australia as a child whose parents are unknown.

A05.specification: Person must be 'ordinarily resident' (as defined in AUS 3.) in Australia throughout the period of 10 years from birth.
A05.category: Generally applicable provision (before age of majority)

A06.specification: Person must have been lawfully resident in Australia for 4 years immediately prior to making the application and holding permanent resident status for the last 12 months of that period. Other conditions: sit a citizenship test (English language skills and knowledge about Australia and Australian citizenship), Minister must be satisfied that the person is likely to reside, or to continue to reside, in Australia or to maintain a close and continuing association with Australia, and person is of good character at the time of the Minister's decision.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A06a.specification: Person must have been lawfully resident in Australia for 4 years immediately prior to making the application and holding permanent resident status for the last 12 months of that period. Minister must be satisfied that the person is likely to reside, or to continue to reside, in Australia or to maintain a close and continuing association with Australia.

A06d.specification: Person is required to sit a citizenship test (English language skills and knowledge about Australia and Australian citizenship).

A06e.specification: Person must be of good character at the time of the Minister's decision.
A06e.category: General requirement without specification (good moral character)

A08.specification: n.a. Note: No direct basis for acquisition. Person who is the spouse of a citizen has to apply in his/her own right under mode A06. However, under AUS 22(9), where a person is the spouse, de facto partner or surviving spouse of a citizen at the time of making his/her application, the Minister may treat a period in which the person was not present in Australia but was spouse/de facto partner, and was a permanent resident of Australia, and had a close and continuing connection with Australia, as a period in which the person was present in Australia for the purposes of satisfying the general residency requirement.

A10.specification: Person is adopted under a law in force in a State or Territory of Australia by a citizen present in Australia as a permanent resident at that time.; Person is adopted in accordance with the Hague Convention on Intercountry Adoption or a bilateral agreement by a citizen present in Australia for a total period of at least 2 years at any time before the person made the application.
A10.category: Generally applicable provision (adopted child can be minor or adult)

A06c.specification: Person is required to sit a citizenship test (English language skills and knowledge about Australia and Australian citizenship).
A06c.category: Language requirement with certification or test

A12a.specification: Person is born outside of Australia and is the child of a former Australian citizen who lost his/her citizenship under pre-2002 provisions which provided for loss of citizenship on acquisition of another citizenship.
A12a.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A12b.specification: Person is the child of a deceased citizen who died before the birth.
A12b.category: Generational restriction: only applies to child or grandchild

A14.specification: n.a.
A14.category: No provision

A16.specification: Person is eligible to become a citizen again if s/he ceased to be a citizen through renunciation in order to acquire or retain the citizenship of a foreign country or to avoid suffering significant hardship or detriment. Resumption provisions also apply to a child who lost his or her own citizenship as a result of his or her parent(s) ceasing to be citizens for the above reasons.
A16.category: Mode restriction: only if citizenship was lost on particular grounds

A18.specification: Person satisfies the Minister that she or he was born in Papua before 16 September 1975 to a citizen born in Australia (as that term is understood at the time of the application) and is of good character.

A24.specification: Person is employed by the Commonwealth government in a position that requires a security clearance as high or higher than the nominated level, or participates in an Australian team in certain competitions, or is engaged in 'particular kinds of work requiring regular travel outside Australia'. Other conditions: see A06 (but at variance with the standard naturalisation requirements, provision is made for 'special' i.e. less onerous, residence requirements for those seeking to engage in an activity of benefit to Australia, where the person needs to be an Australian citizen to engage in that activity and there is insufficient time for that person to comply with the general residence requirements).
A24.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A25.specification: Person has performed a 'relevant defence service'. Other conditions: see A06 (except that provision is made for 'special' i.e. less onerous, residence requirements).

A06f.category: No requirement

AUT.name: Austria
AUT.value: No group or gender restriction coded
AUT.naturalisation_language_condition: Language requirement with certification or test
AUT.refugee_route: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)
AUT.stateless_route: Additional restrictions apply (eg citizenship status of parent)

A01a.specification: Person is born in Austria to a citizen.

A03b.specification: Person was born in Austria, has been stateless since birth and resident in Austria for at least 10 years, 5 years of them uninterrupted and immediately before the application. Application for citizenship at the age of 18 or 19. Other condition: not convicted for certain crimes.

A04.specification: Person was born out of wedlock to a foreign national mother and Austrian father recognises the child within 8 weeks after the birth.; Person is an unmarried minor born out of wedlock obtains Austrian nationality when she or he has not become Austrian national by birth, her/his father is an Austrian national and the parents get married.
A04.category: Other restrictions (age, marriage or other conditions apply)

A05.specification: Person is born in Austria and has been resident there for 6 years immediately before the application. Other conditions: see mode A06.
A05.category: Generally applicable provision (before age of majority)

A06.specification: Person has been resident in Austria for 10 years, of which 5 years with a permanent resident permit immediately before the application (can be reduced to six years if person has proof of sustainable personal integration). Other conditions: no criminal convictions, the granting of citizenship must not have an adverse impact on the international relations of the Republic of Austria and the person must have an <d4>affirmative attitude towards the Republic of Austria<d5>, and he or she must not represent a danger to public law, order and security including any other public interest that is covered by Art. 8(2) ECHR, secure income, renunciation or automatic loss of previous citizenship(s) (unless legally impossible or unreasonable due to high fees), proficiency in German (B1 CEFR, certification), knowledge of Austrian democratic order and history and of the federal province responsible for the administration of naturalisation (naturalisation test). Person is entitled to naturalisation if he/she has proof of sustainable personal integration as mentioned above.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A01b.specification: Person is born abroad to a citizen.

A06b.specification: Person has renounced or automatically lost previous citizenship(s) (unless legally impossible or unreasonable due to high fees).

A06c.specification: Person is proficient in German (B1 CEFR, certification).
A06c.category: Language requirement with certification or test

A06d.specification: Person has knowledge of Austrian democratic order and history and of the federal province responsible for the administration of naturalisation (naturalisation test).

A06e.specification: Person has no criminal convictions, the granting of citizenship must not have an adverse impact on the international relations of the Republic of Austria and the person must have an <d4>affirmative attitude towards the Republic of Austria<d5>, and he or she must not represent a danger to public law, order and security including any other public interest that is covered by Art. 8(2) ECHR.
A06e.category: Exclusion for certain specified crimes, offences or character queries and general moral character condition applies

A06f.category: Requirement (conditions not further specified in database)

A08.specification: Person has been the spouse of a citizen for 5 years, with common household, and has been resident in Austria for 6 years, with a permanent residence permit at the time of the application. No residence requirement if the person left Austria with his/her spouse before May 9, 1945. Other conditions: see mode A06.

A10.specification: Person younger than 14 years obtains Austrian nationality when adopted by an Austrian national. Conditions: The person must live in Austria or the adopting Austrian must live outside Austria for at least 12 months. The granting of citizenship must not have an adverse impact on the international relations of the Republic of Austria and the person must have an <d4>affirmative attitude towards the Republic of Austria<d5>, and he or she must not represent a danger to public law, order and security including any other public interest that is covered by Art. 8(2) ECHR.
A10.category: Generally applicable provision (adopted child can be minor or adult)

A12b.specification: Person is the child of a deceased citizen.
A12b.category: Generational restriction: only applies to child or grandchild

A13.specification: Person has been the spouse for 5 years, with common household, of a person who acquires citizenship. Person has been resident in Austria for 6 years, with a permanent residence permit at the time of the application. No previous withdrawal of Austrian citizenship based on employment in non-military public service of another country. If the spouse has acquired Austrian citizenship based on special achievements: no residence requirement, required duration of marriage or renunciation requirement. Other conditions: see mode A06.

A14.specification: Person is an unmarried minor (or handicapped adult in need of care), has not lost citizenship by withdrawal due to employment in military service or non-military public service of another country, and father or mother is acquiring citizenship by naturalisation (or is already a citizen).  Person must have a permanent residence permit at the time of the application. If mother or father has acquired Austrian citizenship based on special achievements: no residence requirement or renunciation requirement. Other conditions: see mode A06. Also children of this unmarried minor acquire Austrian citizenship under the condition of the renunciation of former citizenships.; Unmarried person whose parents acquire citizenship by legitimation (see mode A04)
A14.category: Age restriction: only if child is minor

A16.specification: Person was a citizen for 10 years, lost citizenship otherwise than by withdrawal, and is resident in Austria. Administrative infractions are not relevant for the criminal record.; Other conditions: see mode A06.; Person lost citizenship, otherwise than by withdrawal, while a minor is legally present in Austria and requests reacquisition of citizenship at the age 18 or 19. Other conditions: see mode A06.; Person lost citizenship due to acquisition of citizenship of another country by spousal extension or spousal transfer and applies for reacquisition of citizenship within 5 years after the end of marriage. Other conditions: see mode A06.
A16.category: Mode restriction: only if citizenship was lost on particular grounds

A16.specification: Person was a citizen for 10 years, lost citizenship otherwise than by withdrawal, and is resident in Austria. Administrative infractions are not relevant for the criminal record.; Other conditions: see mode A06.; Person lost citizenship, otherwise than by withdrawal, while a minor is legally present in Austria and requests reacquisition of citizenship at the age 18 or 19. Other conditions: see mode A06.; Person lost citizenship due to acquisition of citizenship of another country by spousal extension or spousal transfer and applies for reacquisition of citizenship within 5 years after the end of marriage. Other conditions: see mode A06.; Person has moved abroad as a citizen or national of one of the successor states of the former Austro-Hungarian Monarchy or as a stateless person, in each case with his or her principal place of residence in the Federal territory, before 15 May 1955 because they had reason to fear or suffered persecution by NSDAP organs or the authorities of the German Empire, or because they were subjected to persecution or had reason to fear such persecution on account of his advocacy of the democratic Republic of Austria. Or person is a descendant in the direct descending line of a person who has acquired or could have acquired citizenship on this ground. Person must fulfil certain grounds for security-related conditions for acquisition of citizenship.
A16.category: Mode restriction: only if citizenship was lost on particular grounds

A18.specification: Person is a citizen of the European Economic Area and has been resident in Austria for 6 years immediately before the application. Other conditions: see mode A06.

A20.specification: Person acquires Austrian citizenship if he/she has been mistakenly treated as Austrian citizen by public authorities for a period of fifteen years or having served in the armed forces/alternative civil service. Application must be made within six months after the discovery of the erroneous treatment. Other conditions: no criminal convictions (but less stricter conditions than A06), the granting of citizenship must not have an adverse impact on the international relations of the Republic of Austria and the person must have an <d4>affirmative attitude towards the Republic of Austria<d5>, and he or she must not represent a danger to public law, order and security including any other public interest that is covered by Art. 8(2) ECHR. renunciation of other citizenship is not required.; Person had mistakenly been treated as Austrian by descent because a determination of paternity and it has subsequently been shown that none of the reasons for ius sanguinis apply. Retroactive acquisition of Austrian citizenship from the date of birth or legitimation (no further conditions).
A20.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A21.specification: Person has been resident in Austria for 15 years, can prove effective personal and professional integration, and has not previously lost citizenship due to withdrawal or renunciation. No proof of integration is required if the person has been resident in Austria for 30 years. Other conditions: see A06.
A21.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A22.specification: Person is a recognised refugee and has been resident in Austria for 10 years immediately before the application. Renunciation of former citizenships not required. Other conditions: see mode A06.
A22.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A23.specification: Person born abroad, mother or father are according to the law of that country (but not according to Austrian law) Austrian citizens and the person would be stateless
A23.category: Additional restrictions apply (eg citizenship status of parent)

A24.specification: Person has been resident in Austria for 6 years and acquisition of citizenship due to past and expected future special achievements in science, economics, arts or sports is in the interest of Austria. Other conditions: see mode A06.; Person with past and expected future  special achievements in the special interest of Austria (constitutional provision). No residence or secure income requirement, no German knowledge, no naturalisation test and no renunciation of previous citizenships. Other conditions: see mode A06.
A24.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A26.specification: Person has been resident in Austria for 6 years and acquisition of citizenship due to past and expected future special achievements in economics is in the interest of the country. Other conditions: see A06.
A26.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A03a.specification: Person is found in Austria of unknown parentage and is younger than 6 months.

A06a.specification: Person has been resident in Austria for 10 years, of which 5 years with a permanent resident permit immediately before the application. Residence requirement can be reduced to six years if person has proof of sustainable personal integration.

AZE.name: Azerbaijan
AZE.value: No group or gender restriction coded
AZE.naturalisation_language_condition: Language requirement with certification or test
AZE.refugee_route: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A01b.specification: Person is born abroad to a citizen.

A03a.specification: Person is a child living in Azerbaijan and of unknown parentage.

A01a.specification: Person is born in Azerbaijan to a citizen.

A03b.specification: Person is born in Azerbaijan to parents who are both stateless.
A03b.category: Parental status restriction: only if one or both parents are stateless (additional residence requirement may apply)

A06.specification: Person has had 5 years of permanent and uninterrupted residence. Other conditions: knowledge of language (certificate), legal source of income, commitment to abide by the Constitution. Application is rejected if the person calls for forcible change of the state structure set by the Constitution of the Azerbaijan Republic, for disturbing its territorial integrity, performs activities that cause damage to state security, public order, the health and morality of the population, propagandises racial, religious and national hatred, or has relations with terrorist activities.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A06a.specification: Person has had 5 years of permanent and uninterrupted residence.

A06d.specification: Commitment to abide by the Constitution.

A06e.specification: Application is rejected if the person calls for forcible change of the state structure set by the Constitution of the Azerbaijan Republic, for disturbing its territorial integrity, performs activities that cause damage to state security, public order, the health and morality of the population, propagandises racial, religious and national hatred, or has relations with terrorist activities.
A06e.category: Exclusion for certain specified crimes, offences or character queries

A06f.category: Requirement (conditions not further specified in database)

A08.specification: n.a.

A06c.specification: Knowledge of language (certificate) required.
A06c.category: Language requirement with certification or test

A14.specification: Person is a child under 14 years old and both parents (or his/her one known parent) are acquiring citizenship. If one parent is acquiring citizenship and the other parent is a foreigner, the child acquires citizenship upon the request of the parent acquiring citizenship, provided that the other parent consents. If one parent is acquiring citizenship and the other parent is a stateless person, the child acquires citizenship, provided that s/he lives in the country. If one parent is acquiring citizenship and the other parent is a stateless person, a child who does not live in the country acquires citizenship upon the request of the parent acquiring citizenship, provided that the other parent consents.
A14.category: Age restriction: only if child is minor

A16.specification: Person has previously been a citizen of the Azerbaijan Republic, or his/her citizenship has been terminated. No conditions, but application will be rejected for the reasons listed under mode A06.
A16.category: Generally applicable provision

A22.specification: Person is a refugee who was settled in the territory of the Azerbaijan Republic from 1 Jan 1988 until 1 Jan 1992.
A22.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A23.specification: Person is stateless. Other conditions: see A06.

A24.specification: Person has high achievements in the sphere of science, technics, culture or sport, or the person represents a special interest for the country. No conditions, but application can be rejected for the reasons listed under mode A06.
A24.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A25.specification: Person has rendered great service to the country. No conditions, but application can be rejected for the reasons listed under mode A06.
A25.category: Generally applicable provision (applicable to military and public service)

A10.specification: Person is adopted by parents who are both citizens. If only one parent is a citizen, the child will acquire citizenship by consent of the adopters. Child's consent is required if s/he is between 14 and 18 years old.
A10.category: Age restriction: only if adopted child is a minor

BDI.name: Burundi
BDI.gender_restriction_modes: Marriage: Gender differentiation (residence requirement differs by gender)

A01a.specification: Person is the child of a citizen (constitution), or person is born in wedlock to a father who is a citizen, or is recognised by voluntary or court-ordered legitimation as the child of a Burundian father, or paternal descent is not established and the child is recognised voluntarily or by court order as the child of a Burundian mother, or the child is repudiated by the father and the mother is a citizen (law).

A01b.specification: Constitution: person is the child of a citizen. Law: person is born in wedlock to a father who is a citizen, or is recognised by voluntary or court-ordered legitimation as the child of a Burundian father, or paternal descent is not established and the child is recognised voluntarily or by court order as the child of a Burundian mother, or the child is repudiated by the father and the mother is a citizen.

A06.specification: Person has been resident at least 10 years. Other conditions: at least 21 years old (or if less, application submitted with that of a parent), good conduct, behaviour and customs, no convictions for crime or other offence, attachment to the Burundian nation and assimilation with Burundian citizens.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A06c.specification: Attachment to the Burundian nation and assimilation with Burundian citizens required.

(In both cases the residence requirement can be shortened with 1 year if applicant meets language requirements.) Other conditions: Person's identity is established in the meaning of FIN 6. Person has not committed a punishable act (unless the punishment has been a summary penal fee) nor has a restraining order been issued against him/her, has not materially failed to provide maintenance or meet pecuniary obligations under public law, can provide a reliable account of livelihood, has satisfactory oral and written skills in the Finnish or Swedish language or similar skills in the Finnish or Finland-Swedish sign language (language skills requirement). Exceptions to these requirements are possible only on grounds that have explicitly been laid down in the Nationality Act. A person meeting these requirements will not be naturalised if there is a justified reason for suspecting that naturalising the person jeopardises the State's security or public order, or the main aim of naturalisation is to take advantage of a benefit related to Finnish citizenship without any purpose to reside in Finland, or if naturalisation is otherwise against the interest of the State for a weighty reason and in light of the overall consideration of the person's situation.

(A spouse means the husband or wife of the citizen or a person cohabiting with the citizen in a relationship resembling marriage. Provisions on a spouse also apply to a registered partner.) Other conditions: see A06.

(FIN 2(1)(8)).; A child acquires Finnish citizenship by birth if the deceased father was Finnish citizen and married to the child's mother or the child is born in Finland the paternity of the deceased father, who was Finnish citizen, is established. What is said about the deceased father whose paternity is established also applies to a deceased mother whose maternity is established under the Maternity Act. (FIN 9(1)(3) and 9(3))

A20.specification: Person has, through no fault of his or her own, been considered a Finnish citizen for a minimum of 10 years as a result of such a mistake made by a Finnish public authority which has led to a serious consequence related to the rights and obligations of a Finnish citizen. In addition it is required that the person has strong ties to Finland on the basis of a long period of lawful residence in the country or for some other similar reason, and has been permanently resident in Finland for the last 2 years without interruption. Other conditions: see A06. See also A21.

In addition, one of the following three conditions must be fulfiled: i) it is unreasonably difficult to be engaged in permanent full-time work in Finland without citizenship, ii) person has, through no fault of his or her own, been considered a Finnish citizen for a minimum of 10 years as a result of such a mistake made by a Finnish public authority which has led to a serious consequence related to the rights and obligations of a Finnish citizen (see A20), or iii) there is otherwise special and weighty reason. (FIN 18b(1)(2))

If paternity is established after the marriage was contracted but before the person reaches the age of 18, citizenship is acquired as of the date when the paternity was established (FIN11).; Person is born in Finland out of wedlock to a father who was a citizen at the time of the person's birth, and whose paternity was established after the person reaches the age of 18 or gets married, or the person is born outside Finland out of wedlock to a father who  was a citizen at the time of the person's birth, and whose paternity was established (FIN 26). What is said about the father whose paternity is established in Sections 9(1)(2)(b), 9(1)(3)(b) and 26 also applies to mother whose maternity is established under the Maternity Act (253/2018).

Entitlement to register as a British citizen if person is a minor whose parent acquired citizenship by descent and has resided at any time in the UK for 3 years: entitlement while child is minor. The parent's own British parent must have acquired citizenship otherwise than by descent. Other conditions: good character if person is over 10 years old. OR person is a minor whose parent is a citizen by descent and the child and both parents (unless one is dead or divorced) live in the UK for a period of three years and both parents consent (unless one parent has died). Other conditions: good character if person is over 10 years old.
A01b.category: Generational transmission restriction: conditional on birthplace/place of residence /mode under which parent acquired citizenship

A01b.specification:

The parent's own British parent must have acquired citizenship otherwise than by descent. Other conditions: good character if person is over 10 years old. Person may not be an ineligible person ex Illegal Migration Act (i.e. due to irregular entry) OR person is a minor whose parent is a citizen by descent and the child and both parents (unless one is dead or divorced) live in the UK for a period of three years and both parents consent (unless one parent has died). Other conditions: good character if person is over 10 years old. Person may not be an ineligible person ex Illegal Migration Act (i.e. due to irregular entry)
A01b.category: Generational transmission restriction: conditional on birthplace/place of residence /mode under which parent acquired citizenship
