A26.article: JOR 13(2), Cabinet decisions No. 6800 of 2 October 2019
A26.specification:
Person can acquire citizenship without a four-year residence requirement if the applicant's naturalization benefits the public interest. Other conditions: see A06 (except the residence requirement). Conditions include satisfying one of the following four options as well as a security and financial solvency check (and are limited to 500 investors a year): 

(1) Making a zero-interest, three-year 1 million dollar (this likely refers to U.S. dollars, it explicitly does not refer to Jordanian dinar) deposit at the Central Bank of Jordan that the investor does not withdraw during that period and buying treasury bonds of the same value at an interest rate to be decided by the Central Bank of Jordan for 6 years.

(2) Buying shares/stocks worth at least 1 million dollars in Jordanian companies and investing 750,000 dollars in small and medium enterprises for no less than three years (with certification of these purchases provided by the relevant authority). 

(3) Setting up an investment project or investment projects in any productive economic sector (according to existing legal provisions for non-Jordanian investments) and paying 1.5 million dollars if the project(s) is registered in the Amman (capital) governorate (or paying 1 million dollars in other governorates), provided that the project(s) creates at least 20 job opportunities registered with the Social Security Corporation for Jordanians and remains operational for at least three years.

(4) Having an overall average total value of fixed assets in an existing project or an overall share/dividend of an existing project (according to certified annual budgets) during the last three years worth at least 1 million dollars in the Amman (capital) governorate (or 700,000 dollars in other governorates) for each partner that also provided at least 20 jobs for Jordanians (or 15 jobs in other governorates) during the last three years according to the Social Security Corporation.

An investor who obtains Jordanian nationality under one of these provisions can obtain Jordanian nationality for his: wife, his unmarried, widowed, or divorced daughters who live in his care/protection, unmarried sons no older than 18 years old when applying, and parents if they are dependent on him. An investor whose investment exceeds 3 million dollars also can obtain Jordanian nationality for his sons who are no older than 30 years old when applying as well as those sons' wives and children.
A26.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A06f.category: Requirement (conditions not further specified in database)

A06.specification: Person has been resident in Chad for 15 years. Other conditions: no physical or mental incapacity that could be a charge on the collectivity, no conviction for crime subject to imprisonment. Granted by joint decree of ministers of interior and public health. If decree is not issued within 1 year of application, it is considered rejected.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A10.specification: Person is a minor who is adopted by a citizen.
A10.category: Age restriction: only if adopted child is a minor

A03a.specification: Child born in Chad to unknown parents.

A03b.specification: Person is born in Chad and has no other citizenship at birth.

A14.specification: Person is a minor whose parents are jointly acquiring citizenship and include the child in their application.
A14.category: Age restriction: only if child is minor

A16.specification: Person is a former citizen. Reintegration is granted by decree of minister of interior, with no conditions related to age or time limits. No person who has been deprived of citizenship can be reintegrated unless s/he rendered exceptional services.
A16.category: Mode restriction: only if citizenship was lost on particular grounds

A20.specification: Person is of 'African origin' (de souche africain), has been living in Chad for 15 years, and with 'apparent status' as a citizen (possession d'etat de Tchadian).  Conditions to show apparent status: assimilated to a community living in Chad, always been treated as Chadian by the population and the authorities, and of good conduct (bonne vie et moeurs).  Authority responsible for issuing certificates of nationality (the prefet) considers if conditions are shown. Authorities can reject by decree within 1 year after the 15 years required for an application.
A20.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A24.specification: Person was born in Chad and rendered 'exceptional services'. Other conditions: see A06 (except that 15 years of habitual residence and health conditions do not apply).
A24.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A06c.specification: n.a.
A06c.category: No requirement

A06e.specification: No conviction for crime subject to imprisonment.
A06e.category: Exclusion for certain specified crimes, offences or character queries

A08.specification: Person is the spouse of a citizen and requests for citizenship at the time of celebration of the marriage. Government can oppose acquisition of citizenship within 1 year of marriage.

A01a.specification: Person is born in Chad to a citizen.

TGO.name: Togo
TGO.gender_restriction_modes: Marriage: Gender differentiation (residence requirement differs by gender)
TGO.naturalisation_language_condition: Language requirement without certification or test

A02b.specification: Person is born in Togo to parents who were both born there and has habitual residence in Togo and apparent status (possession d'etat) as Togoloese.

A03a.specification: Person is found as a child under the age of 5 in Togo of unknown parents.

A03b.specification: Person is born in Togo and cannot claim any other citizenship.

A08.specification: Person is a woman who marries a citizen (unless she declines citizenship).; Person is a child who marries a Togolese citizen
A08.category: Gender differentiation (residence requirement differs by gender)

A06a.specification: Person has been habitually resident for at least 5 years.

A06b.specification: Renunciation of citizenship of another country required.

A06c.specification: Person must be assimilated to Togolese community especially by knowledge of a Togolese language.
A06c.category: Language requirement without certification or test

A06e.specification: Person is of good character, not sentenced to imprisonment for more than 2 years.
A06e.category: Exclusion for certain specified crimes, offences or character queries and general moral character condition applies

A24.specification: Person has rendered exceptional services to Togo or naturalisation represents an exceptional interest for the country. Other conditions: see A06 (except residence requirement may be waived).
A24.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A06.specification: Person has been habitually resident for at least 5 years. Other conditions: over 21 years old, Togo is the centre of principal interests, good character, not sentenced to imprisonment for more than 2 years, good mental and physical health, renounce other citizenship, assimilated to Togolese community especially by knowledge of a Togolese language.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A01a.specification: Person is born in Togo to a citizen.

A10.specification: n.a.
A10.category: No provision

A06f.specification: Person has good mental and physical health.
A06f.category: Requirement (conditions not further specified in database)

A14.specification: Person is the child of a father who is acquiring Togolese citizenship. Other conditions: not married, has not served in army of country of origin, has not been expelled, has not been sentenced to 6 months imprisonment.
A14.category: Age restriction: only if child is minor

A01b.specification: Person is born abroad to a citizen.

A20.specification: Person was born in Togo to foreign parents and has apparent status (possession d'etat) of Togolese since 16 years old, and makes a declaration accepted by the council of ministers.
A20.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A23.specification: Person is born in Togo of parents whose place of birth is unknown. (Note: unclear whether any of the conditions listed under A06 apply.)

A16.specification: Person is a former citizen who is habitually resident in Togo. Other conditions: was not deprived of citizenship (unless exceptional circumstances apply).
A16.category: Mode restriction: only if citizenship was lost on particular grounds

THA.name: Thailand
THA.value: Group (race, religion or ethnic group) and gender restrictions
THA.group_restriction_modes: Birth in country (acquisition after birth): Group restriction: only if person is member of a particular group, race or religion
THA.gender_restriction_modes: Marriage: Gender restriction: only for female spouse of male citizen (no residence requirement); Spousal coacquisition: Gender restriction: only applies to female spouses (without residence requirement)
THA.naturalisation_language_condition: Language requirement without certification or test
THA.cultural_affinity_route: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)
THA.stateless_route: Additional restrictions apply (eg citizenship status of parent)

A06d.specification: A person who has had a domicile in Thailand for a consecutive period of not less than five years holds the permanent resident permit and is proficient in speaking and listening to the Thai language.

A02a.specification: A person is born in Thailand to both foreign parents holding a permanent resident permit in Thailand and not enjoying diplomatic immunity nor representing another country. Note: A person born in Thailand to foreign parents with temporary immigration status or illegal immigrants falls is subject to additional regulations set by the Cabinet, for which the Minister of Interior will approve Thai nationality for each particular person. That additional regulation usually depends on Thailand's policy at a particular time (e.g. the policy to solve statelessness and to assimilate the children born to former forced migrants, refugees and migrant workers).

A01a.specification: Person is born in Thailand to a Thai citizen.

A06c.article: Nationality Act B.E.2508 (1965) 10(5),  Ministerial Regulation B.E.2510 (1967) issued under the Nationality Act 1965 2,  Ministerial Regulation on Forms, Modes, and Fees to Apply for Acquiring Thai Nationality, Naturalising to Become a Thai, and Restoring Thai Nationality in the Case of an Ethnic Minority B.E.2545 (2002) Ministerial Regulation for an Ethnic Minority' 4
A06c.specification: Ability to speak and listen the Thai language. <ca>There is no certification requirement. (Note: in practice a person must be able to sing the Thai Royal Anthem).
A06c.category: Language requirement without certification or test

A04.article: Nationality Act B.E.2508 (1965) 7(2), Ministerial Regulation on the Methods and Fees for Applying for Thai Nationality by Descent for a Child of a Thai Biological Father B.E.2553 (2010)
A04.specification: Person has evidence<d1>a court judgement, or the recognition of being a legitimate child, DNA evidence, witness<d1>that he was born to a Thai male.<ca>
A04.category: Generally applicable provision (no further conditions besides recognition/legitimation/establishment of parentage)

A05.specification: A person born in Thailand who does not have Thai nationality as a result of the impact of Revolutionary Party Regulation No. 337 (Por Wor 337) since 13 December 1972, including his or her child born in Thailand in a second generation, shall live continuously in Thailand, as evidenced by being registered in the Civil Registration of Thailand, and have good behavior, or prove his/her dedicating a distinguishing service for Thailand. Note: a person born in Thailand to foreign parents with temporary immigration status or illegal immigrants qualifies for the additional regulations set by the Cabinet, which usually depend on Thailand's policy at a particular time.
A05.category: Group restriction: only if person is member of a particular group, race or religion

A06.article: Nationality Act B.E.2508 (1965) 10, 12, 5, Ministerial Regulation B.E.2510 (1967) issued under the Nationality Act 1965, Ministerial Regulation on Forms, Modes, and Fees to Apply for Acquiring Thai Nationality, Naturalising to Become a Thai, and Restoring Thai Nationality in the Case of an Ethnic Minority B.E.2545 (2002) or Ministerial Regulation for an Ethnic Minority'
A06.specification: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A01b.specification: Person is born abroad to a Thai citizen.

A19.article: Nationality Act B.E.2508 (1965) 9/5, 9/6, 9/7,  Ministerial Regulation on the Verification and Recognition of the Status of Displaced Thai B.E.2555 (2012)
A19.specification: Person is recognised as the Displaced Thai which is contingent upon the verification of the fact that his/her ethnic Thai ancestors were made subjects of another state because of the territorial succession of Thailand in the past, together with other conditions that such a person does not have the nationality of another country, immigrates to and resides for a period of time in Thailand, observes the Thai ways of life, as well as being verified and registered in Thailand's civil registration.
A19.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A03a.article: No specific provision, but the government interprets Article 7 of the Nationality Act B.E.2508 (1965), CURRENTT version, to imply
A03a.specification: Person has evidence showing the possibility of  birth in Thailand (no explicit provisions, governmental interpretation of Art. 7 of the Nationality Act B.E.2508 (1965)). The situation of unknown parents could not mean his/her parents are not permanent residents.

A03b.specification: n.a.

A06f.specification: Having a well found occupation with reference and the ability to make a living in Thailand<ca>
A06f.category: Requirement (conditions not further specified in database)

A08.article: Nationality Act B.E.2508 (1965) 9, 5,  Ministerial Regulation B.E.2510 (1967) issued under the Nationality Act 1965
A08.specification: Person is a foreign woman who legally married a Thai man.<ca>
A08.category: Gender restriction: only for female spouse of male citizen (no residence requirement)

A06a.specification: An applicant has had a domicile in Thailand for a consecutive period of not less than five years until the date of filing the naturalisation application. This timeframe is not required for persons who: render distinguished service to Thailand, are the child, wife, or a naturalised or restored Thai citizen, used to have Thai nationality, are the husband of a Thai citizen.

A06e.specification: Good morals, clean criminal record, no activities hostile to Thailand
A06e.category: Exclusion for certain specified crimes, offences or character queries and general moral character condition applies

A13.article: Nationality Act B.E.2508 (1965) 11(2)(5), 12, 5, Ministerial Regulation B.E.2510 (1967) issued under the Nationality Act 1965
A13.specification: Person is the wife of a naturalised or restored Thai citizen. Five-year consecutive domicile in Thailand and knowledge of the Thai language not required. Other requirements: see A06
A13.category: Gender restriction: only applies to female spouses (without residence requirement)

A14.article: Nationality Act B.E.2508 (1965) 11(2), 12, 5, Ministerial Regulation B.E.2510 (1967) issued under the Nationality Act 1966;  Nationality Act B.E.2508 (1965) 11(2), 12, 5, Ministerial Regulation B.E.2510 (1967) issued under the Nationality Act 1966
A14.specification: Person is a child of a naturalised or restored Thai citizen. No five-year consecutive domicile in Thailand, knowledge of the Thai language, good behavior, or occupation required. Other requirements: see A06.; Person is a descendant of those who have been recognised as the Displaced Thai.
A14.category: Age restriction: only if child is minor

A14.article: Nationality Act B.E.2508 (1965) 11(2), 12, 5, Ministerial Regulation B.E.2510 (1967) issued under the Nationality Act 1966;  Nationality Act B.E.2508 (1965) 11(2), 12, 5, Ministerial Regulation B.E.2510 (1967) issued under the Nationality Act 1966
A14.specification:
Person is a child of a naturalised or restored Thai citizen. No five-year consecutive domicile in Thailand, knowledge of the Thai language, good behavior, or occupation required. Other requirements: see A06.; 
Person is a descendant of those who have been recognised as the Displaced Thai.
A14.category: Age restriction: only if child is minor

A16.article: Nationality Act B.E.2508 (1965) 23, 24, 5, Ministerial Regulation B.E.2510 (1967) issued under the Nationality Act 1966;  Nationality Act,  no. 4, B.E.2551 (2008) 23
A16.specification: Person is a former Thai man or woman who marries a foreigner and renounces his or her Thai nationality, but the marriage is terminated and a former Thai who, while being an underage child, had lost his or her Thai nationality together with his father or mother.; Person is a former Thai born in Thailand, whose Thai citizenship has been revoked as a result of Revolutionary Party Regulation No. 337 (Por Wor 337) since 13 December 1972, must live continuously in Thailand, as evidenced by being registered in the Civil Registration of Thailand, and have good behavior, or demonstrate a distinguished service to Thailand.
A16.category: Mode restriction: only if citizenship was lost on particular grounds

A10.article: Nationality Act B.E.2508 (1965) 12/1, 12, 5, Ministerial Regulation B.E.2510 (1967) issued under the Nationality Act 1965
A10.specification: Person is an underage child adopted by a Thai citizen for not less than five years, person is an incompetent person being cared for by a Thai guardian under the Court order, or person is a minor under the care of the foster home for not less than ten years. The first two groups shall have evidence demonstrating their birth in Thailand.
A10.category: Generally applicable provision (adopted child can be minor or adult)

A23.article: Nationality Act B.E.2508 (1965) 4, 7bis(2),  Ministerial Regulation on the Verification and Recognition of the Status of Displaced Thai B.E.2555 (2012)
A23.specification: Person who is stateless and recognised as the Displaced Thai under the conditions of A19.
A23.category: Additional restrictions apply (eg citizenship status of parent)

A24.article: Nationality Act B.E.2508 (1965) 11(1), 12, 5, Ministerial Regulation B.E.2510 (1967) issued under the Nationality Act 1965
A24.specification: Applicant for naturalisation to become a Thai has rendered distinguished service to Thailand or has done acts to the benefit of official service. There are no requirements for having a five-year consecutive domicile in Thailand and knowledge of the Thai language.
A24.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

TJK.name: Tajikistan
TJK.value: No group or gender restriction coded
TJK.naturalisation_language_condition: Language requirement without certification or test

A01b.specification: Person is born abroad to a citizen. If one of the parents is a foreigner and neither of the parents are permanent residents in the country, written agreement between the parents is required (acquisition is automatic if the parents fail to agree within 3 months from the child's birth and the child remains stateless).

A03a.specification: Person is born in Tajikistan and of unknown parentage.

A01a.specification: Person is born in Tajikistan to a citizen.

A06a.specification: Person has had permanent and continuous residence for 5 years.

A06b.specification: Renunciation of other citizenship required (unless person is a Russian citizen (bilateral treaty)).

A06c.specification: Knowledge of the language (level of communication)
A06c.category: Language requirement without certification or test

A03b.specification: Person is a child born in Tajikistan to stateless parents and at least one parent permanently resides in the country. Or child is born to parents who are citizens of other countries and the child is not entitled to citizenship of these countries.
A03b.category: Parental status restriction: only if one or both parents are stateless (additional residence requirement may apply)

A04.specification: Person is born to a stateless mother, irrespective of the place of birth, and an affiliation is established with the child's father who is a citizen.
A04.category: Other restrictions (age, marriage or other conditions apply)

A24.specification: Person has outstanding achievements in the sphere of science, technology, healthcare or sports, achievements in the economic, social and cultural development of the country and the realisation of universal human values. No other conditions.
A24.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A06.specification: Person has had permanent and continuous residence for 5 years. Other conditions: knowledge of the language (level of communication) and not being under criminal prosecution, renunciation of other citizenship (unless a bilateral treaty applies).
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A09.specification: Person has a parent who is a citizen and has had permanent and continuous residence for 2.5 years. Other conditions: see A06.
A09.category: Generally applicable provision (child can be minor or adult)

A10.specification: Persons is adopted by a citizen or a couple one of whom is a citizen and the other is stateless. If one of the adopting parents is a foreigner, the child acquires citizenship based on an application submitted by the adoptive parents.
A10.category: Generally applicable provision (adopted child can be minor or adult)

A14.specification: Person is the child of a parent who is acquiring citizenship. Child's consent is required if between 14 and 18 years.
A14.category: Age restriction: only if child is minor

A16.specification: Person was born on the territory of the Soviet Socialist Republic of Tajikistan, held citizenship of the former Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, and has been resident for 2.5 years. Other conditions: see A06. Or person was born in the Soviet Socialist Republic of Tajikistan, was in possession of the citizenship of former Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, resided or resides in the states that are former members of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, but has not acquired citizenship of these states and, as a result, is stateless.; Person is a veteran of WW II, possessed citizenship of the former Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, and lives in Tajikistan. Or person previously was a citizen and applies to have citizenship restored. No other conditions.
A16.category: Generally applicable provision

A06e.specification: Person is not under criminal prosecution.
A06e.category: Exclusion for certain specified crimes, offences or character queries

A23.specification: Person is a stateless person and has had permanent and continuous residence for 2.5 years. Other conditions: see A06.

A08.specification: n.a.

A06f.category: No requirement

TKM.value: No group or gender restriction coded
TKM.naturalisation_language_condition: Language requirement without certification or test

TKM.refugee_route: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A10.specification: Person is adopted by two citizens or by a parent who is a citizen and another who is stateless, and the person is resident in Turkmenistan. If one adoptive parent is a foreigner, the written consent of both spouses is required. Child's consent is required if between 14 and 18 years.
A10.category: Age restriction: only if adopted child is a minor

A24.specification: Persons have rendered outstanding services to Turkmenistan, have high achievements in science, technology, culture or sport, or have a profession or qualification of state interest. Other conditions: see A06 (but residence requirement may be shortened).
A24.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A22.specification: Person is recognised as a refugee in accordance with the law or international treaty to which Turkmenistan is a party. Other conditions: see A06 (but residence requirement may be shortened).
A22.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A06b.specification: Renunciation of citizenship of another country required (unless person is a Russian citizen (bilateral treaty)).

A06c.specification: Knowledge of the official language (communication level) required.
A06c.category: Language requirement without certification or test

A06d.specification: Assumes the responsibility to abide by and respect the Constitution and laws of the country.

A06e.specification: Person must meet security and public policy checks (list of reasons for refusal).
A06e.category: Exclusion for certain specified crimes, offences or character queries

A06f.category: Requirement (conditions not further specified in database)

A01b.specification: Person is born abroad to a citizen. If one parent has foreign citizenship and neither of the parents have resided habitually in the country before the child's birth, a joint application of both parents is required (not needed if the child does not acquire another citizenship).

A11.specification: Person is a citizen of the former USSR, and either has a close relative in Turkmenistan or has arrived for the purpose of habitual residence. Other conditions: see A06 (but residence requirement may be shortened).
A11.category: Generally applicable provision (applies to relatives in ascending and descending line)

A08.specification: n.a.

A01a.specification: Person is born in Turkmenistan to a citizen.

A06a.specification: Person has been habitually resident for 5 years.

A03a.specification: Person is a child who is resident in Turkmenistan and of unknown parentage. Child shall be regarded as born in Turkmenistan.

A03b.specification: Person is a child born in Turkmenistan to stateless parents (or single parent) who habitually reside in the country, or is the child of foreign citizens and cannot acquire the parents' (or single parent) citizenship.
A03b.category: Parental status restriction: only if one or both parents are stateless (additional residence requirement may apply)

A04.specification: Person is born to a mother who is stateless and a citizen is recognised as the father.
A04.category: Other restrictions (age, marriage or other conditions apply)

A06.specification: Person has been habitually resident for 5 years. Other conditions: knowledge of the official language (communication level), assumes the responsibility to abide by and respect the Constitution and laws of the country, legal sources of subsistence, and meet security and public policy checks (list of reasons for refusal).
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A14.specification: Person is the child of parents (or single parent) who are acquiring citizenship. If one parent remains a foreign citizen, a joint application of both parents is required. Child's consent is required if between 14 and 18 years.
A14.category: Age restriction: only if child is minor

A19.specification: Person belongs to the Turkmen people or is a descendant of such a person (children, grandchildren, great grandchildren and others). Other conditions: see A06 (but residence requirement may be shortened).
A19.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A16.specification: Person is a former citizen and is habitually resident or has an intention to settle in the country. Other conditions: see A06 (except requirements relating to residence and means of subsistence).
A16.category: Generally applicable provision

TLS.name: Timor-Leste
TLS.value: No group or gender restriction coded
TLS.naturalisation_language_condition: Language requirement without certification or test

A24.specification: Person is granted citizenship, by the National Parliament, for having rendered high and relevant services to the country.
A24.category: Provision exists (conditions not further specified in database)

A06d.specification: Moral and civic guarantees of integration into Timorese society required, knowledge of the history and culture of Timor-Leste required.

A06e.specification: One of the grounds for opposition is conviction for crime punishable with prison sentence of more than 8 years or for crime against the internal and external security of the state.
A06e.category: Exclusion for certain specified crimes, offences or character queries

A06e.specification: One of the grounds for opposition is conviction for crime punishable with prison sentence of more than 8 years or for crime against the internal and external security of the state.
A06e.category: Exclusion for certain specified crimes, offences or character queries

A06f.specification: Capacity to govern oneself and to provide for own subsistence required.
A06f.category: Requirement (conditions not further specified in database)

A08.specification: Person has been married for more than 5 years with a citizen. Other requirements: residence in Timor-Leste for at least 2 years, ability to speak one of the official languages. If the previous citizenship is lost as a consequence of the marriage, Timorese citizenship is acquired automatically. Note: a Ministerial Decree from 2018 made naturalisation on the basis of marriage a discretionary decision, even in cases where the foreign spouse lost his/her citizenship as a consequence of the marriage. This MD's legality is highly questionable. Grounds for opposition: clear inexistence of any effective ties to the Timorese society, conviction for crime punishable with prison sentence of more than 8 years or for crime against the internal and external security of the state, unauthorised exercise of sovereign functions for a foreign state, rendering of military service to a foreign state outside of cases explicitly authorised.

A01a.specification: Person is born in Timor-Leste to a citizen.

A10.specification: Person is a minor who is adopted by a citizen. Grounds for opposition: clear inexistence of any effective ties to the Timorese society, conviction for crime punishable with prison sentence of more than 8 years or for crime against the internal and external security of the state.
A10.category: Generally applicable provision (adopted child can be minor or adult)

A14.specification: Person is the minor child of a parent who acquires Timorese citizenship by naturalisation, provided that the parent requests for the child to also acquire citizenship. Grounds for opposition: clear inexistence of any effective ties to the Timorese society, conviction for crime punishable with prison sentence of more than 8 years or for crime against the internal and external security of the state.
A14.category: Age restriction: only if child is minor

A16.specification: Person lost citizenship by declaration of his/her parents when he/she was a minor. Person must have reached the age of majority and must have established residence in Timor-Leste for at least 1 year.; Person voluntarily renounced citizenship and has established residence in Timor-Leste for at least 5 years. Grounds for opposition: clear inexistence of any effective ties to the Timorese society, conviction for crime punishable with prison sentence of more than 8 years or for crime against the internal and external security of the state, unauthorised exercise of sovereign functions for a foreign state, rendering of military service to a foreign state outside of cases explicitly authorised.
A16.category: Mode restriction: only if citizenship was lost on particular grounds

A16.specification: Person lost citizenship by declaration of his/her parents when he/she was a minor. Person must have reached the age of majority and must have established residence in Timor-Leste for at least 1 year.; Person voluntarily renounced citizenship and has established residence in Timor-Leste for at least 5 years. Grounds for opposition: clear inexistence of any effective ties to the Timorese society, conviction for crime punishable with prison sentence of more than 8 years or for crime against the internal and external security of the state, unauthorised exercise of sovereign functions for a foreign state, rendering of military service to a foreign state outside of cases explicitly authorised.
A16.category: Mode restriction: only if citizenship was lost on particular grounds

A01b.specification: Person is born abroad to a citizen and the birth is registered with the Timorese Civil Registry.

A02b.specification: Person is born in Timor-Leste to a person also born there.

A03a.specification: n.a.

A03b.specification: Person is born in Timor-Leste to unknown parents or to parents who are stateless or of unknown citizenship.
A03b.category: Parental status restriction: only if one or both parents are stateless (additional residence requirement may apply)

A05.specification: Person is born in Timor-Leste to foreign parents and declares, of his/her own accord and after reaching the age of 17 years, that he/she wishes to acquire citizenship.
A05.category: Age restriction: person can only acquire citizenship after reaching the age of majority

A06.specification: Person has been habitually and legally resident in Timor-Leste for at least 10 years counted before 7 December 1975 or after 20 May 2002. Other requirements: full age under Timorese law and under the law of the State of origin, ability to speak one of the official languages, moral and civic guarantees of integration into Timorese society, capacity to govern oneself and to provide for own subsistence, knowledge of the history and culture of Timor-Leste. Grounds for opposition: clear inexistence of any effective ties to the Timorese society, conviction for crime punishable with prison sentence of more than 8 years or for crime against the internal and external security of the state, unauthorised exercise of sovereign functions for a foreign state, rendering of military service to a foreign state outside of cases explicitly authorised.
A06.category: Generally applicable provision (see further conditions under A06a-A06f)

A06a.specification: Person has been habitually and legally resident in Timor-Leste for at least 10 years counted before 7 December 1975 or after 20 May 2002.

A06c.specification: Ability to speak one of the official languages required.
A06c.category: Language requirement without certification or test

_meta.title: Citizenship laws that favour or exclude people by race, religion, ethnic group or sex
_meta.what: For 191 countries, how each of 34 ways of getting citizenship (by descent, birth in the country, marriage, naturalisation, etc.) is regulated, coded by GLOBALCIT from the laws in force on 1 January of each year 2020-2024. value flags whether, in 2024, any route is limited to members of a particular group, race or religion ("Group restriction"), or treats men and women differently ("Gender restriction"/"Gender differentiation"), e.g. mothers cannot pass citizenship to children, or only wives of male citizens can naturalise by marriage. Also shown: language and civic/assimilation conditions for naturalisation, and preferential routes for people of the same culture or ethnicity ("cultural affinity", A19). Every mode, with article, procedure, specification and category, is kept in "modes" for every year (identical years grouped).
_meta.source: Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Džankić, Honohan, Manby, GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.1, Country-Year-Mode Data (Acquisition), Global Citizenship Observatory / EUI Robert Schuman Centre
